reason: I've drunk the same energy drink for years and I know exactly how it hits on a night shift; I'm not swapping that for something I've never tried. Money isn't the issue, but if I wanted yerba mate I'd just grab YEAHRBA on Rohlík where it's cheaper and lands with my groceries.
objection: Every brand says natural now, so that alone doesn't tell me anything, and 80 mg in a slim can doesn't tell me it'll carry me through a 4 a.m. stretch the way my usual drink does.
would_change_my_mind: Being handed a free cold can at a café before a shift and finding it actually keeps me sharp without the crash, and seeing it on Rohlík so it fits my normal order.
